title: Model security
description: Scanning is tied to an immutable commit and scanner generation. Download decisions are enforced by the server.
revisionHint: Choose a revision. Evidence is tied to the commit that revision resolves to.
versionEvidence: Version and report identity · expand to inspect or copy
reportDescription: Inspect each file's coverage, digest and recorded risk evidence.
fileEvidenceHint: Expand a file row for engine results and risk locations. Scroll horizontally to inspect all fields.
tasksDescription: Follow scan progress and previous attempts. Canceled or failed tasks cannot supply complete admission evidence.
auditsDescription: Trace scanning, policy changes and actual server decisions for protocol downloads.
policyDescription: Risk thresholds and evidence completeness are checked separately. Only administrators can change the policy.
noTasksDescription: This model has no scan tasks yet. Track progress here after uploading a revision or requesting a rescan.
noAuditsDescription: No audit entries are available for this model. Entries follow actual scan, policy or access operations.

overview.findingsHint: Recorded findings; zero does not imply a complete pass

statusHints.pending: Complete scan results are not available. Awaiting tasks and evidence.
statusHints.scanning: Scan evidence is being updated. The completed report provides the final result.
statusHints.pass: The scan report passed. Downloads still require valid evidence, the current policy and revision checks.
statusHints.warn: The scan report contains risk warnings. Inspect the evidence and current policy.
statusHints.block: The scan report is blocked. Inspect file findings and the current policy.
statusHints.fail: Complete, valid scan results were not obtained. Failure does not imply a malicious file.

unavailableNotice: Model scanning is disabled or the scanner service is unavailable. Other model features remain accessible.
revisionInvalid: Enter a valid revision of at most 1024 characters.
rescanNotice: Queue a new scan for this revision. The server resolves the revision again; previous evidence will not authorize this attempt.
cancelNotice: Cancel this scan task. Incomplete or canceled evidence cannot authorize downloads.
coverageNotice: The complete manifest and scan evidence are not yet available. This report cannot be treated as a completed pass.
historicalNotice: Historical evidence for this report ID. Current download authorization also depends on the current scanner generation, policy and repository identity.
noFilesDescription: A pending or incomplete report may not contain file evidence. A complete empty manifest contains zero files.

referenceEvidence.title: Restricted loader reference
referenceEvidence.observation: A static reference was found. The scanner did not execute it; this finding alone does not prove a call or malicious behavior.
referenceEvidence.capability: This loader can deserialize nested data. A reference to this restricted capability is classified as high risk; the current policy determines admission.
referenceEvidence.offset: Opcode byte offset within the artifact or archive member
referenceEvidence.rootArtifact: Root artifact; no archive member chain
referenceEvidence.compatibility: Legitimate legacy PyTorch Storage files may also contain this reference and be blocked. Prefer a trusted producer's pure tensor-data format when suitable; do not load an untrusted pickle to convert it.
referenceEvidence.unavailable: Structured reference evidence is unavailable or uses an unsupported schema. No symbol or position has been inferred.

sources.pickletools: The static opcode reader supplied the recorded position. Member names are represented by hashes rather than rendered as model-provided text.
sources.picklescan: Picklescan reported a reference. If it supplies no exact location, the stream, offset and member chain remain unavailable.

policyNotice: Enforce mode blocks findings at or above the selected severity. Audit mode records risk decisions but still rejects missing, stale or incomplete evidence.

policy.updateError: Could not update the security policy

reviews.title: Human review
reviews.notice: Reviews append audit records only. They do not change machine scan results or download admission. A false-positive opinion does not unblock downloads.
reviews.appendOnly: Saved records cannot be edited or deleted. Append another review to make a correction.
reviews.terminalRequired: Select a terminal report with a report ID. Pending or running scans cannot receive a human review.
reviews.readOnly: You can read reviews. Adding a review requires write access to this repository.
reviews.commentHint: Explain your reasoning in 1–1000 Unicode characters. Do not paste executable payloads or credentials.
reviews.commentInvalid: After trimming whitespace, the comment must contain 1–1000 Unicode characters without NUL.
reviews.emptyDescription: This report has no human review. Machine results and admission policy remain in effect.

revisionPicker.commitHint: Select by title, date and short SHA. Security queries use the complete immutable commit ID.
revisionPicker.choose: Choose a commit on this page
revisionPicker.noMatches: No matching commits on this page
revisionPicker.empty: No commits are available for this branch or tag.
revisionPicker.error: Could not load commits. Check repository access.
revisionPicker.refsError: Could not load branches and tags.
revisionPicker.reportMismatch: The returned report belongs to a different commit. Evidence is hidden; retry the selected revision.
